WT32-ETH01 and its USB-C dock, OLED 128×64, joystick KY-023
2 × MAX3485 module (U1, U2), XLR-3 male and female panel sockets
3.5 mm TRS panel jack and TRS MIDI cable (Type A)
1 × USB-C breakout with 5.1 kΩ on CC1 and CC2 (J1)
1 × USB-C charger 5 V, 1 A, and a cable
2 × push button 6 mm (SW1, SW2), 1 × pin header 3 pins (J2)
1 × DMX terminator for the last fixture (XLR-3 male, 120 Ω on pins 2 and 3)
Perfboard, hook-up wire. Optional: 3.3 V USB-serial adapter for J2
U1 (DMX OUT): remove the 120 Ω resistor. U2 (DMX IN): keep it (R5).
Put all GND wires on one GND rail and all 3V3 wires on one 3V3 rail.
Connect each rail to the WT32-ETH01 with one short wire.
Flash the board once with the dock. After that, the box updates over the network.
Firmware 1.24.0 and later drive MIDI, the LEDs, DMX OUT, DMX IN,
GND symbol: to the GND rail
1. Power the OLED, the joystick and the two MAX3485 modules from 3V3, not from 5 V. At 5 V, they put 5 V on ESP32 pins.
2. U1 (OUT): remove its 120 Ω resistor; the last fixture has the terminator. U2 (IN): keep it; the box ends the console line.
3. The jack is TRS Type A. A Type B device swaps tip and ring: use a Type A to B adapter.
4. To flash over J2: adapter TX to RX0, adapter RX to TX0, GND to GND. Hold BOOT, push RST, release BOOT.
5. Power comes from J1 during the flash. Do not connect the 5 V pin of the adapter. Do not use J1 and the dock together.
6. Do not connect IO2 and IO12. IO2 is the receive pin of the MIDI UART. IO12 high at power-on stops the start.
7. The firmware calibrates the joystick center at each start. Do not touch the joystick while the box starts.
